problems.what: B19: LOST trust questions your promises and remembers failures of protection
problems.with: trust to question your promises, remember when you failed to protect him/her, and take
problems.from: second reader of the refix (rf), triaged

let_stand.finding: B15: UNCLEAR "outside caretaker" became "the caretaker in the other person" (no referent)
let_stand.why: limit kept: the adult part isn't handed to someone outside; 'the other person' reads as that someone

let_stand.finding: B15: INVENTED "let someone take care of you" listed as something that comes forward
let_stand.why: fits the list (vulnerability, need, fewer decisions); the adult stays present, so the limit holds

let_stand.finding: B15: SHIFT "play" narrowed to "silliness"
let_stand.why: synonym-level wording in a 'such as' list of examples

let_stand.finding: B19: SHIFT "tell me what feels unsafe" became "what is not okay"
let_stand.why: same request to the child to say what is wrong; 'not okay' covers 'unsafe'

let_stand.finding: B19: LOST "that isn't a way to end the complaint"
let_stand.why: carried by 'Then respond to the complaints'; the script is not the end of it

let_stand.finding: B19: INVENTED complaints "sure to come", child "not completely right"
let_stand.why: elaboration that fits: the script invites complaints, and 'listen for what is true' already implies some may not be

let_stand.finding: B19: INVENTED changing yourself to be less likely to turn on the child
let_stand.why: elaboration of repairing after an internal attack; 'make up to him/her' is kept

let_stand.finding: B19: LOST good behavior without love is a "colder performance"
let_stand.why: same limit: 'just not hitting back is not enough, you need to love'; not hitting back is listed as showing love

let_stand.finding: B19: SHIFT "boundaries" became "setting limits for him/her"
let_stand.why: near-synonym, one item among the care acts; 'boundaries' stays in the Protector stretch

let_stand.finding: B19: UNCLEAR "It might not be chronological age" (what is not age; "don't decide from age" lost)
let_stand.why: same sense: which position it is isn't set by age; 'it' follows the separate/one/blended questions

let_stand.finding: B19: INVENTED weighing how valuable the younger self's action was
let_stand.why: elaboration that fits; 'given what they knew at the time' keeps the question, and harm and repair are kept

let_stand.finding: B19: SHIFT "options they could see" became "options they had"
let_stand.why: wording; 'given what they knew' and 'how tolerable they were' keep the same lens

let_stand.finding: B29: LOST Nurturer brings warmth
let_stand.why: warmth is carried by enjoying the child, being happy they are there, and the warm lines

let_stand.finding: B29: LOST child needs enjoying "not only comforted when hurt"
let_stand.why: contrast clause; 'Children need to be enjoyed' keeps the point

let_stand.finding: B29: LOST script "I'm glad you're here"
let_stand.why: sense kept in 'Be happy that they are there'; the lines are examples ('like:')

let_stand.finding: B29: LOST script "I will stay"
let_stand.why: 'I'm here for you' keeps presence and the Protector's 'not leave you' keeps staying; example list shortened

let_stand.finding: B32: LOST Protector turns warmth into something the child can believe
let_stand.why: same point carried by 'You build trust by being able to do adult things'

let_stand.finding: B32: SHIFT "adult consequences" and "handle the consequence" became "adult things"
let_stand.why: wording; the examples before it (texting, not eating) make it about acting

let_stand.finding: B32: LOST a protective act can begin the relationship when warmth is unavailable
let_stand.why: same point: if the warm stuff is hard, do something protective

let_stand.finding: B32: LOST review what actually happened
let_stand.why: 'figure out what's getting in the way' and the questions keep the review

let_stand.finding: B32: UNCLEAR last sentence on success, feeling good, checking off; "tick doesn't prove it helped" lost
let_stand.why: awkward but the same two points: success isn't feeling good or ticking it off
